_about: The system packages and downloaded programs of every install path: the hosted image (scripts/image/customize.sh),
a self-hosted Linux server (scripts/install-linux.sh), the dev environment (scripts/dev-env/srt/install-srt.sh,
scripts/dev-env/install-trial.sh) and an office Mac (scripts/office/office-install.sh). A feature that needs a system
package or a program adds it here, never to one script (docs/REPOSITORY-RULES.md). Read by scripts/system/packages.sh;
checked by tests/unit/system-packages.test.ts. Shipped in every Linux bundle as root/packages.json, so a changed list
is a root change (rootSince) and mycel-ctl update brings a server to it (packages.sh sync).
groups.<g>.install: always = every install, also --minimal; default = every install unless --minimal, and the image;
on-request = only a script that names the group (image: customize.sh; srt: install-srt.sh and the image; boxes:
Package versions: the distribution release is pinned (distros; the installers accept no other), each package may
carry a floor ">=V" that is checked after the install (dpkg --compare-versions), and the newest version of that
release is installed, security updates included. A package value is ">=V", "" (any version) or
Artifacts are pinned exactly: one version, and a url, sha256 and size for every platform. A new browser: take the
download its four chrome-headless-shell zips, and write their sha256 (shasum -a 256) and size here.

core.for: the sandbox (bwrap), the engine firewall (nft), downloads and unpacking. Floors: Debian 12, the oldest release

documents.for: the server's own converters: PDF pages and HEIC photos

media.for: video and audio the AI reads (ffmpeg, ffprobe)

fonts.for: Korean, Japanese and Chinese in what the browser prints and the dev environment draws; Arial-compatible Latin

devenv.for: the dev environment's commands and srt (socat, ripgrep). Installing them turns nothing on: install-srt.sh does

browser.for: HTML to PDF (server/src/files/html-pdf.ts): the pinned chrome-headless-shell and the libraries it loads (ldd of the linux64 and linux-arm64 builds on each system)

image.for: the hosted team VM (scripts/image/customize.sh): guest agent, time, zram, security updates, no SSH server

srt.for: the dev environment on srt (install-srt.sh, the image with --srt): node in /opt/trina/node, srt in /opt/trina/srt/<version>

boxes.for: the dev environment trial on podman boxes (scripts/dev-env/install-trial.sh)

test-vm.for: the dev environment's test VM (scripts/dev-env/vm-setup.sh, with the boxes group): vm-tests.sh measures with time and bc

chrome-headless-shell.for: Chrome for Testing, Stable channel (googlechromelabs.github.io/chrome-for-testing). Google publishes no checksums: the sha256 are of the files downloaded on 2026-11-07. Installed in /opt/trina/chrome-headless-shell/<version>/<dir> on Linux and <prefix>/browser/chrome-headless-shell/<version>/<dir> on an office Mac, with a link current

node.for: srt's runtime (srt needs 22.12 or later, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY 22.21; Debian 13 has 20). sha256 from the release's SHASUMS256.txt

srt.for: @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime. install-srt.sh installs it with npm ci from scripts/dev-env/srt/package-lock.json, which pins this tarball (its sha512 integrity is the same file as this sha256)
